people.name: Ahaz
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jotham

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Tiglath-pileser
people.line: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel

people.name: Uriah
people.line: Priest during the reign of King Ahaz

translations.web: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.
translations.bsb: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria. On seeing the altar in Damascus, King Ahaz sent Uriah the priest a model of the altar and complete plans for its construction.
translations.kjv: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
translations.asv: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
